body:
Application to amend zoning for 333 Albert Street
Changes to the Zoning By-law for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
The Planning Partnership is proposing to construct a 6-storey mixed-use development with a proposed building floor area of 1,497 square metres, consisting of 85 dwelling units (85 bedrooms), 33 vehicle parking spaces, and 365 square metres of commercial space.
A Zoning By-law Amendment is required in order to amend the City’s Zoning By-law by removing the “H” Holding provision from the subject lands. The lands will be rezoned from “(Holding) Residential Northdale Six” ((H)RN-6) to “Residential Northdale Six (RN-6).
Approval of this application will help final approval of site plan application (SP-23-03). The holding provision ensures that planning objectives for the property are met.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: 21.40 metres
Number of units: 85 units with 85 bedrooms
Unit sizes: one bedroom units
Housing types: apartments
Commercial space: 365 square metres
Parking
Parking: 33
Bicycle parking: 26
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
